newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud rights first leg 37 pct subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Exbud rights first leg 37 pct subscribed.

text.p: Shareholders of the Polish construction firm Exbud SA registered for 729,613 shares, or 36.5 percent of two million shares offered at 23 zlotys each in the first round of a rights issue, Exbud said on Monday.

The company said in a statement that the remaining shares would be available in a second leg from September 2 to September 16. The first round of the one-for-four rights issue was held between July 22 and August 12.
Exbud has said it would use the funds to add firms to its holding and to buy new equipment.
